summary: Hawthorn Bancshares filed an 8-K to report second-quarter 2026 financial results and approve a quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per common share, payable October 1, 2026. These are routine disclosures of operating performance and ordinary dividend declarations, not special-situation events. No M&A activity, strategic review, restructuring, or other special situations are referenced. The filing is purely informational under Items 2.02 and 8.01, with no deal terms or structural changes to analyze.
